personalInfo.name: Muhammad Usama
personalInfo.title: Flutter Developer
personalInfo.bio:
Hey there! I'm Muhammad Usama, a passionate Flutter Developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience building amazing mobile applications!

What I Do:
I transform ideas into reality through beautiful, high-performance cross-platform apps. I've successfully delivered 30+ production-ready applications that are live on App Store and Play Store, serving thousands of users worldwide!

My Superpowers:
• Expert in Flutter (iOS, Android & Web)
• Master of clean architecture and design patterns
• State management wizard (GetX, Provider, Riverpod, Bloc)
• API integration specialist (REST, GraphQL, WebSockets)
• Real-time features enthusiast (GPS tracking, live chat)
• Payment gateway pro (Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay)

What Makes Me Different:
I don't just write code—I craft solutions! I excel at team leadership, project management, and ensuring on-time delivery without compromising quality. I've managed remote teams, coordinated sprints, and turned tight deadlines into successful launches.

Fun Fact:
While pursuing my BS in IT at Bahria University, I've shipped 30+ apps including big brands like Coca-Cola (Coke D2H). Talk about multitasking!

Let's build something amazing together!
